## Selected work

- [Mavera](https://sheharyarishfaq.com/work/mavera) (lead software engineer, 2024 to 2026): AI market-intelligence platform used by 120+ companies. Built it end to end, then led the developers who joined. Next.js, Rust, MCP, Kubernetes.
- [Bina.ai](https://sheharyarishfaq.com/work/bina) (Mistral LLM × Law Hackathon, Paris, October 2026, first place, team of five): briefs for litigation funders, with every quote checked word for word against the ruling.
- [AIWrappers](https://sheharyarishfaq.com/work/aiwrappers) (client project, 2025): an agent builds AI tools as web apps on the customer's own domain, routing requests to 38 models from five providers on each owner's own keys.
- [Caracat at LIP6](https://sheharyarishfaq.com/work/caracat) (research project, 2026): with a teammate, compared a Rust traceroute engine with its C++ predecessor and found matching outputs. Graded 86/100, third of twelve.
- [BirdCLEF+ 2026](https://sheharyarishfaq.com/work/birdclef) (machine learning): classical ML on 35.5K recordings of 206 bird species, 0.922 macro ROC-AUC.
